newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit slightly weak, but in range on strong dlr.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit slightly weak, but in range on strong dlr.

text.p: The ringgit was weaker, but within recent ranges in late Asian trading as the dollar continued gaining against other major currencies, dealers said on Monday.
They said the ringgit was following dollar/majors and some early momentum provided by speculative buying of the Malaysian unit petered out quickly.

"U.S. names out of Singapore were seen loading up ringgit on the back of talk of another trade surplus for October after posting hefty surpluses in both August and September," research firm I.D.E.A. said in an early comment.
However, I.D.E.A. said it expected a trade deficit in October due to increased imports.
Some dealers said the ringgit would remain in a 40-point range in the near future, with strong technical support at 2.5220 and resistance at 2.5180 level.
A dealer with a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur said an offshore loan syndication facility of between $300-$400 million would be converted to ringgit in the next few days.
"This would counter the year-end repatriation of funds and prevent ringggit's fall," he said.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5222/29 a dollar.
